name: Austin

city_filter.note: Filter parcels by the City of Austin jurisdiction polygons, not by an appraisal field: https://services.arcgis.com/0L95CJ0VTaxqcmED/arcgis/rest/services/BOUNDARIES_jurisdictions/FeatureServer/0 where CITY_NAME = 'CITY OF AUSTIN'. JURISDICTION_TYPE values for Austin: FULL (full purpose), LTD (limited purpose, zoning applies), 2MILE, 2MILE_AG and 5MIL (ETJ, no zoning). The TCAD export has a situs city, which is a mailing city. Austin also reaches into Williamson and Hays counties; only Travis is loaded.

zoning_layer.note: City of Austin zoning polygons (Geospatial Services, Data Development), hosted on the city's ArcGIS Online org. 22,502 polygons, 558 distinct ZONING_ZTYPE strings on 2026-11-17. ZONING_ZTYPE is the full string with combining districts (SF-3-NP, CS-MU-V-CO-NP, I-SF-2); the match column lists every string seen for each base district. ZONING_BASE is too coarse to use (SF, MF, CS). A twin layer PLANNINGCADASTRE_zoning_large_map_scale has the same strings. New strings appear as rezonings pass; re-pull the distinct list in the nightly job and map by the leading base district. Spatial reference is Texas Central state plane feet (wkid 2277); ask for outSR=4326. maxRecordCount 2000.

overlay_layers.note: National Register historic districts, 20 polygons. Local historic districts and landmarks are not a separate polygon layer: they are the -HD and -H tokens in ZONING_ZTYPE.
City historic landmarks, 689 points, with CASE_NUMBER.

City of Austin fully developed floodplain, 12,042 polygons. This is the floodplain the city regulates. Values include 'City of Austin Fully Developed 100-Year Floodplain' and '25-Year'. FLOODWAY field.
FEMA floodplain for greater Austin, 9,315 polygons. Values: A, AE, AO, .2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD, X PROTECTED BY LEVEE.
Neighborhood conservation combining districts, 16 polygons. Their ordinances replace base district numbers.
Boundary of the Subchapter F (Residential Design and Compatibility Standards) area, 1 polygon. HOME floor area limits apply only inside it.
ETOD density bonus subdistricts: Subdistrict 1 (120 ft), Subdistrict 2 (90 ft). Bonus path, not computed.
Waterfront overlay subdistricts along Lady Bird Lake, 17 polygons; extra setbacks and limits.
Barton Springs Zone, 1 polygon; lower impervious cover limits under the water quality rules.
Capitol view corridors, 35 polygons; height limits by elevation.
Airport overlay zones AO-1, AO-2, AO-3 and the controlled compatible land use area; residential use is limited in some. Not the same as the SB 840 3,000 ft airport distance.
University Neighborhood Overlay (West Campus), 21 polygons with a HEIGHT field; opt-in bonus rules.
Wildland-urban interface code areas, 79,263 polygons; adds building code requirements, not zoning limits.
City limits and ETJ for Austin and nearby cities, 388 polygons. Zoning applies in FULL and LTD only.

permit_source.note: Issued Construction Permits, City of Austin open data. 2,385,678 rows on 2026-11-17, no key needed. All permit types; filter permittype = 'BP' and work_class = 'New'. permit_class holds the Census class: 'R- 101 Single Family Houses', 'R- 103 Two Family Bldgs', 'C- 105 Five or More Family Bldgs'. Useful fields: permit_number, issue_date, tcad_id (10 digits, joins to TCAD geo_id), housing_units, total_new_add_sqft, total_job_valuation, number_of_floors, total_lot_sq_ft, latitude, longitude, jurisdiction, status_current, certificate_of_occupancy. Valuation is often 0 on residential permits.

appraisal_source.format: zip (557 MB) of fixed-width text files, one record per line, no header; column positions are in the layout zip (PDF and XLSX, Legacy 8.0.33 Appraisal Export Layout). Files: PROP.TXT (4.9 GB, 9,922 bytes per record), IMP_DET.TXT (2.1 GB), IMP_INFO.TXT, IMP_ATR.TXT, LAND_DET.TXT, PROP_ENT.TXT (9.8 GB), plus small lookup files.
appraisal_source.export_date: 2026-07-18 (2026 certified roll); a later 2026 supplemental export is also posted

fields.parcel_id: PROP.TXT prop_id (cols 1-12) and geo_id (cols 547-596); geo_id is the 10-digit TCAD ID used in city permits
fields.market_value: PROP.TXT market_value (cols 4214-4227); appraised_val (cols 1916-1930); land and improvement values at cols 1796-1855
fields.land_area: PROP.TXT land_acres (cols 2772-2791, 4 implied decimals); LAND_DET.TXT has square feet per land segment
fields.living_area: IMP_DET.TXT area per segment (1st Floor, 2nd Floor, garage, porch); living area is the sum of the living segments. There is no single living-area field in PROP.TXT
fields.use: PROP.TXT imprv_state_cd and land_state_cd (cols 2732-2751): A1 house, B1 apartments, F1 commercial

appraisal_source.note: Free download, no sign-up. Read by HTTP range requests on 2026-11-17: the zip listing and the first rows of PROP.TXT, IMP_DET.TXT, LAND_DET.TXT and IMP_INFO.TXT were parsed against the layout. The exact column positions inside IMP_DET.TXT and LAND_DET.TXT were not mapped. No sale prices: Texas is a non-disclosure state. Parcel polygons: https://services.arcgis.com/0L95CJ0VTaxqcmED/arcgis/rest/services/EXTERNAL_tcad_parcel/FeatureServer/0 (386,682 polygons; PROP_ID and PID_10 join to the export).

disclaimer: Estimates, not tax, legal, zoning or appraisal advice. Prices are appraisal district market values, not sale prices.

official code (blocks automated requests; not opened)
small lot subdivisions and flag lots: 25-4-232, 25-4-177 (third-party copy of Chapter 25-4)
City of Austin Guide to Zoning, September 2016 (cross-check of the district table)
City of Austin SB 840 page and information sheet

parcel_layer.note: City of Austin copy of the TCAD parcel polygons; PROP_ID joins to prop_id in the appraisal export.

parcel_source: Travis Central Appraisal District 2026 certified appraisal export; lot shapes from the City of Austin TCAD parcel layer
value_source: Travis Central Appraisal District market value, 2026 certified roll

comps.source: Travis Central Appraisal District appraised market value of 1-6 unit buildings built 2019 or later, 2026 roll. Texas does not publish sale prices (Government Code 552.148), so these are appraisals, not sales
